slots.label: How the periodic table is arranged
slots.labelAf: Hoe die periodieke tabel gerangskik is

slots.label: Metals and non-metals on the table
slots.labelAf: Metale en nie-metale op die tabel

items.q: What does each column (group) of the periodic table have in common?
items.qAf: Wat het elke kolom (groep) van die periodieke tabel gemeen?
options: The same number of outer electrons
items.explain: Elements in a group have the same number of electrons in their outer shell, so they react in similar ways.
items.explainAf: Elemente in ’n groep het dieselfde aantal elektrone in hul buitenste skil, so reageer hulle op soortgelyke maniere.

items.q: Across a row (period) from left to right, what happens to the atomic number?
items.qAf: Wat gebeur met die atoomgetal oor ’n ry (periode) van links na regs?
options: It increases by one each step
optionsAf: Dit neem by elke stap met een toe
items.explain: Elements are arranged in order of increasing atomic number, so each step to the right adds one proton.
items.explainAf: Elemente is in volgorde van toenemende atoomgetal gerangskik, so elke stap na regs voeg een proton by.

items.q: Which group contains the noble gases, which are very unreactive?
items.qAf: Watter groep bevat die edelgasse, wat baie onreaktief is?
items.explain: The noble gases are in group 18 (the last column) and have full outer shells, so they rarely react.
items.explainAf: Die edelgasse is in groep 18 (die laaste kolom) en het volle buitenste skille, so reageer hulle selde.

items.q: Where are most metals found on the periodic table?
items.qAf: Waar word die meeste metale op die periodieke tabel gevind?
options: On the left side and in the middle
optionsAf: Aan die linkerkant en in die middel
items.explain: Most elements are metals, and they are found on the left and in the middle of the table.
items.explainAf: Die meeste elemente is metale, en hulle word aan die linker- en middelkant van die tabel gevind.

items.q: Which property is typical of metals?
items.qAf: Watter eienskap is tipies van metale?
options: They are poor conductors of electricity
They conduct electricity and heat well
optionsAf: Hulle is swak geleiers van elektrisiteit
Hulle gelei elektrisiteit en hitte goed
items.explain: Metals are good conductors of heat and electricity, and most are shiny and malleable.
items.explainAf: Metale is goeie geleiers van hitte en elektrisiteit, en die meeste is blink en smeebaar.

items.explain: Oxygen is a non-metal; iron, sodium and copper are metals.
items.explainAf: Suurstof is ’n nie-metaal; yster, natrium en koper is metale.
